TD also serves as a resource to the agency on public transit related matters, including acting as one of the key points of contact with the Metropolitan Transportation Authority (MTA).

TPM seeks a candidate to serve as a Data Analyst within the Planning and Policy team of TD. This is an opportunity to work in a high-profile, fast-paced public sector environment with a team dedicated to improving safety, accessibility, and mobility throughout New York City.

Transportation Planning and Management (TPM) is responsible for the safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible movement of people and goods on the City's streets, supporting the larger goals of economic and social vitality for people living, working, and doing business in New York City. Collaborate with stakeholders across Investment Management, Risk, Operations, Accounting, Treasury, Financial Risk Management, Audit, Hedging, Valuation, Technology, and external vendors to support strategic investment data initiatives.

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related discipline.
Five or more years of experience in financial services with direct responsibility for investment data management, investment operations, or investment technology solutions.
Strong experience designing and improving business processes that increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and strengthen operational controls.
Advanced SQL skills with experience querying large datasets and working with relational databases.
Experience supporting software development or product management activities, including requirements gathering, testing, and UAT.
Experience with investment data processing, including data ingestion, reconciliation, reporting, and downstream integrations.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex formulas, PivotTables, and data analysis techniques.
Working knowledge of investment products and financial markets, particularly fixed income securities and risk analytics.
Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving abilities with exceptional attention to detail.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities while working independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.

Our client is a Houston-based financial services firm specializing in the energy sector, offering integrated Investments, Research, Capital Markets, and Investment Banking services across the energy value chain. They provide strategic advisory and long-term value to clients navigating complex energy transactions.

They're looking for a GIS Specialist to join their Investment Banking team, primarily supporting Upstream engagements with additional work spanning midstream and oilfield services. This person will be involved in a wide variety of deal types, corporate M&A, divestitures, IPOs, equity capital markets transactions, and private capital raises.

This firm operates with a flatter, more entrepreneurial structure than a traditional bank. New team members take on real responsibility quickly, working closely with senior leaders and helping guide a team through the technical complexities facing today's energy businesses.

Responsibilities

Create maps and geospatial visuals used in client-facing deliverables, pitch books, executive summaries, and management presentations
Conduct spatial analysis across acreage positions, well and lease inventories, unit configurations, permitting activity, well spacing, and offset operator positioning in active U.S. basins
Pull, integrate, and quality-check geospatial data from public sources (RRC, BOEM, FERC, EIA, USGS, and state agencies) as well as commercial platforms (Enverus/PRISM, Novi Labs, FactSet), turning raw data into clean, dependable datasets
Validate client-provided and third-party shapefiles during technical due diligence, cross-checking spatial data against deal documentation
Work directly with engineers and bankers to turn geospatial findings into deal-relevant insights, inventory upside, development spacing, acreage contiguity, and basin positioning, that support the broader commercial story
Build automation into recurring GIS workflows to speed up turnaround across multiple active deals
Maintain the firm's internal GIS data library, including layer standards, templates, and version control, so the team can work quickly without losing accuracy
Respond to ad hoc mapping and data requests from bankers and technical staff, often on tight deal timelines

Requirements

A bachelor's degree in Geographic Information Science, Geography, or a closely related field; an advanced degree is a plus
4+ years of professional GIS experience, with a track record supporting upstream oil and gas transactions, A&D advisory, or energy investment banking
Strong hands-on skill with ArcGIS Pro as your primary tool; comfort with ArcGIS Online, QGIS, or Python-based geospatial libraries (arcpy, geopandas) is a plus
Direct experience with Enverus, Novi Labs, or similar business analytics platforms is preferred
Working knowledge of U.S. Lower 48 basin and Gulf of America geology, play areas, and upstream asset structures, with the ability to contextualize geospatial data within a deal setting
A demonstrated ability to produce polished, client-ready maps and exhibits under deal conditions
Strong organizational skills, with the discipline to manage multiple active workstreams at once without sacrificing accuracy
A strong work ethic, clear communication style, and a collaborative approach to teamwork

This is an in-person role based in the firm's Houston office

Do not apply unless you are authorized to work in the United States for any employer as client company cannot sponsor or transfer visas at this time.
